prompt:
Rewrite snippets/recently-viewed-list.liquid so it renders a deduplicated "recently viewed" list. Inputs (all top-level variables; nothing is under section.settings): - products: array, never null, may be empty. Each element is an object with exactly these keys: title (string, never null, may contain < > & " characters), handle (non-empty string, never contains the | character), vendor (string or null). - current_handle: string or null. The handle of the product the shopper is viewing now. - limit: integer >= 0. Maximum number of list items to output. Rules, applied while walking products in array order: 1. Skip any product whose handle equals current_handle. When current_handle is null, nothing is skipped by this rule. 2. Skip any product whose handle exactly equals the handle of a product that was already output earlier (keep the first occurrence). Handles that merely contain another handle as a substring (e.g. "tee" and "tee-shirt") are different and must not be treated as duplicates. 3. Stop once limit items have been output. Skipped products do not count towards the limit. Output format for each emitted product, where N is its 1-based position among the emitted items (not its position in the products array):
  • TITLEVENDOR
    • HANDLE and TITLE are HTML-escaped with the escape filter (TITLE is not stripped). VENDOR is the vendor with leading/trailing whitespace stripped, then escaped. Omit the whole vendor span when vendor is null, empty, or whitespace-only. All items are wrapped in
      ...
    . If no item is emitted (empty array, limit 0, or every product skipped) output nothing at all: an empty string, no empty
      . The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags and no leading/trailing whitespace. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/recently-viewed-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
